    Parameters
    ----------
    image : array_like
        An array-like of the image.

    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)

    horse_patches = image_patch.find("horse")

    # If no horses are found, return "no"
    if not horse_patches:

    horse_patches.sort(key=lambda horse: horse.upper)

    # If the horse is in the front (i.e., it has the smallest upper coordinate), return "yes"
    if horse_patches[0].upper == horse_patches[0].lower:
        return "yes"

    # Otherwise, return "no"
    return "no"

def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    guy_patches = image_patch.find("guy")
    hat_patches = image_patch.find("hat")
    shirt_patches = image_patch.find("shirt")

    if not guy_patches or not hat_patches or not shirt_patches:
        return image_patch

    guy_hat_pairs = [(g, h) for g in guy_patches for h in hat_patches if g.overlaps_with(h.left, h.lower, h.right, h.upper)]
    guy_shirt_pairs = [(g, s) for g in guy_patches for s in shirt_patches if g.overlaps_with(s.left, s.lower, s.right, s.upper)]

    if not guy_hat_pairs or not guy_shirt_pairs:
        return image_patch

    guy_hat_shirt_triples = [
        (g, h, s) 
        for g, h in guy_hat_pairs 
        for s in guy_shirt_pairs 
        if g == s[0] and h != s[1]
    ]

    if not guy_hat_shirt_triples:
        return image_patch

    return guy_hat_shirt_triples[0][0]

modern_c3_q7.program:
def execute_command(image) -> ImagePatch:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    hat_patches = image_patch.find("hat")
    shirt_patches = image_patch.find("shirt")
    
    if not hat_patches or not shirt_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    hat_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in hat_patches]
    shirt_centers = [(p.left + p.right) / 2 for p in shirt_patches]
    
    hat_shirt_pairs = []
    for hat_center in hat_centers:
        for shirt_center in shirt_centers:
            if abs(hat_center - shirt_center) < 10:  # Assuming a tolerance of 10 pixels
                hat_shirt_pairs.append((hat_center, shirt_center))
    
    if not hat_shirt_pairs:
        return image_patch
    
    best_pair = min(hat_shirt_pairs, key=lambda pair: abs(pair[0] - pair[1]))
    hat_patch = hat_patches[hat_centers.index(best_pair[0])]
    shirt_patch = shirt_patches[shirt_centers.index(best_pair[1])]
    
    return hat_patch.crop(max(hat_patch.left, shirt_patch.left), 
                          max(hat_patch.lower, shirt_patch.lower), 
                          min(hat_patch.right, shirt_patch.right), 
                          min(hat_patch.upper, shirt_patch.upper))
